comun.error_texto: We couldn't load this information. Check your connection and try again.

acceso.subtitulo: Transparent traceability, from the plot to the cup.
acceso.error: The email or password is incorrect.
acceso.sesion_vencida: Your session ended. Please sign in again.

portal.bienvenida: This is the new INATrace interface. It is being rolled out module by module: anything not here yet opens in the current version, with the same session.

modulo.vitrina_desc: What consumers see when they scan the QR code.
modulo.stock_desc: Deliveries, processing, payments, orders and traceability.
modulo.empresa_desc: Facilities, users, value chains and catalogs.

portal.resto_actual: The rest, in the current version

vitrina.no_encontrada_texto: The code you scanned does not belong to a published product. The label may not be active yet.

recorrido.intro: Every step this product took, from harvest to your hands.

precios.pedido: Your package is part of order {{pedido}}. Below you can see how much local producers were paid for this order ({{unidad}}), compared with the world market price and the Fairtrade minimum price.
precios.sin_pedido: Below you can see how much local producers are paid ({{unidad}}), compared with the world market price and the Fairtrade minimum price.
precios.mercado_mundial: World market price for Arabica coffee
precios.promedio_sin: Average price paid if not sold as {{producto}}

productores.sin_contenido: This product has no photos or videos of its farmers yet.

calidad.explicacion: The chart compares the quality score of this package of {{producto}} with the minimum of 80 points that the Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) requires for specialty coffee.
calidad.sin_puntaje: This batch has no recorded cupping score.
calidad.sin_certificados: There are no certificates recorded for this batch.

opinion.intro: The producers of {{producto}} would love to know what you think.
opinion.tipo: What would you like to share?
opinion.sabor: How would you rate the taste of {{producto}} compared with other products you consume?
opinion.correo: If you would like a reply, leave your email
opinion.correo_invalido: The email format is not valid.
opinion.consentimiento: I agree that my data may be processed to reply to my comment.
opinion.consentimiento_requerido: We need your consent to send the comment.
opinion.gracias: Your comment has reached the producers.
opinion.error: It could not be sent. Please try again.

previa.sin_publicar: This is how the label «{{titulo}}» will look with the editor's changes. It is not published yet.
previa.publicada: This is how the label «{{titulo}}» will look with the editor's changes, once saved.
previa.sin_opinion: Feedback is not sent from the preview.
previa.vencida_titulo: The preview is no longer available
previa.vencida: Open it again from the label editor.

productores.vacio: There are no farmers in this company yet.
productores.sin_empresa: Your user is not linked to any company. Ask the platform administrator for access.
productores.borrar_confirmar: Delete {{nombre}}? Their plots are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
productores.mapa_ayuda_one: {{count}} plot with a polygon. Tap one to open its farmer's profile.
productores.mapa_ayuda_other: {{count}} plots with a polygon. Tap one to open its farmer's profile.
productores.mapa_vacio: No plot in this company has a polygon yet.

campos.id_interno_ayuda: The code the company uses to identify the farmer.

errores.correo: The email format is not valid.

ubicacion.mapa: Map to locate the farmer: tap to place the pin

finca.sin_catalogo: The company has no crops configured in its value chains.

organizaciones.sin_asociaciones: This company has no associations registered.

parcela.descripcion: Each plot can have its polygon: it is used for the GeoID and EUDR verification.
parcela.vacio: This farmer has no plots registered.
parcela.quitar_confirmar: Remove the plot “{{nombre}}”? It is deleted when you save.
parcela.ayuda_dibujar: Tap the map to place each vertex; tap the first one to close.
parcela.ayuda_editar: Drag the vertices or midpoints to adjust.
parcela.subir_con_cambios: There are unsaved changes in the profile that will be lost when uploading the file. Continue?
parcela.difiere: The declared area ({{declarada}} ha) differs considerably from the drawn one ({{dibujada}} ha). Check which is correct.
parcela.acercate: Zoom in to the plot before drawing.

ficha.nuevo_ayuda: Fill in the details and save to create the farmer.
ficha.revisar: Check the highlighted fields before saving.
ficha.salir_sin_guardar: There are unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

importacion.intro: Load many farmers at once from an Excel spreadsheet.
importacion.paso_plantilla: Download the template and fill it in, one row per farmer.
importacion.solo_excel: Upload only XLS or XLSX files.
importacion.hay_duplicados_one: There is {{count}} possible duplicate to review below.
importacion.hay_duplicados_other: There are {{count}} possible duplicates to review below.
importacion.con_errores_texto: Nothing was imported. Fix these cells and upload it again.
importacion.duplicados_texto: A farmer with the same first name, last name and village already exists. Accept the ones that are different people.

errores.tara_mayor_que_bruto: Tare cannot be greater than the gross weight.
errores.descuento_peso_mayor_que_neto: The damage deduction cannot be greater than the net weight.
errores.descuento_precio_mayor_que_precio: The damage deduction cannot be greater than the price.

entregas.descripcion: Coffee that farmers deliver at the collection facilities.
entregas.borrar_confirmar: Delete the delivery from {{productor}} on {{fecha}}? This cannot be undone.

entrega.parcelas_ayuda: Which plots the coffee comes from. Used for traceability and the EU regulation (EUDR).
entrega.sin_parcelas: This farmer has no registered plots.
entrega.precio_despues_ayuda: The delivery has no payment calculated until the price is set.
entrega.moneda_ayuda: The company has no currency set: type the code (USD, GTQ…).
entrega.resumen_nota: Preview. When saved, the system calculates the final values.
entrega.guardada_otra: Delivery from {{productor}} saved. You can record the next one.
entrega.salir_sin_guardar: The delivery has unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
entrega.con_pagos: This delivery already has payments. If you change quantities or price, the balance is recalculated.

masiva.descripcion: Several deliveries from the same day and facility at once. Shared data is entered once; each farmer has their own quantity and price.

todo.descripcion: What is in each facility: deliveries, processed lots and final products.
todo.elegir_instalacion: Choose a facility to see its stock.
todo.sin_geo: This order has no geographic data.
todo.borrar_confirmar: Delete lot {{lote}}? This cannot be undone.
todo.borrar_proceso_confirmar: Delete the processing that produced lot {{lote}}? All its output lots are deleted. This cannot be undone.
todo.sin_orden_proceso: The processing order for this lot was not found.

traza.sin_historia: This order has no previous processing.

proc.descripcion: Choose the facility and the action: pulping, hulling, transfers, QR code generation… Each action takes input lots and produces new lots with their traceability.
proc.sin_acciones: The company has no processing actions
proc.sin_acciones_texto: They are set up in the company Actions tab:
proc.instalacion_sin_acciones: No actions can be started in this facility.

errores.sin_entrada: Choose at least one input lot.
errores.cantidad_entrada: Check the input quantities: they must be greater than zero and not exceed what is available in each lot.
errores.salida_mayor: The output cannot be more than the input.
errores.sacos_incompletos: Fill in the number and quantity of every sack.
errores.sacos_no_alcanzan: The sacks do not cover the whole output quantity.
errores.sin_proveedor: Choose the supplier (the facility the order goes to).
errores.entrada_mayor_que_pedido: What you send cannot be more than what was ordered.

proc.sin_disponible: No stock available with these filters.
proc.traslado_completo: In a transfer, each lot is moved in full.
proc.cantidad_qr: When generating a QR code, the output equals the input.
proc.rango: Expected output based on the action's yield: {{desde}} to {{hasta}}.
proc.fuera_de_rango: The output is outside that range. Check the quantities; if they are right, you can still save.
proc.borrar_confirmar: Delete this processing? The lots it produced are deleted. This cannot be undone.
proc.traslado_solo_lectura: Saved transfers cannot be edited in the new version. You can view their traceability, or delete and redo them.

qr.descripcion: What the current version prints for {{producto}}: scanning it records the visit and opens the product's public page.
qr.sin_etiquetas: The final product has no published labels, so the QR code has no public page to point to. They are linked in the
qr.nota: To preview it without counting a visit, use "View public page": it opens the page without going through scan logging.

pagos.descripcion: Payments to farmers for their deliveries. A payment is recorded unconfirmed; once confirmed it is closed.
pagos.confirmar_pregunta_one: Confirm this payment? Once confirmed it cannot be undone.
pagos.confirmar_pregunta_other: Confirm these {{count}} payments? Once confirmed they cannot be undone.
pagos.borrar_pregunta: Delete the payment of {{monto}}? The delivery's balance goes back up.
pagos.falta_entrega: The delivery to pay is missing.
pagos.no_se_puede: This delivery cannot be paid yet
pagos.no_se_puede_texto: Only farmer deliveries with a price can be paid. If the price was to be set later, set it on the delivery first.
pagos.de_mas: This is more than the open balance ({{saldo}}). It can still be recorded.
pagos.solo_confirmar: A recorded payment is not edited: it is confirmed once the payment is made, or deleted and recorded again.

errores.documento_pago_base: The base payment needs its supporting document (receipt or purchase sheet).
errores.sin_entregas: There are no deliveries left to pay.
errores.sin_cuenta: Some recipients have no bank account: a bulk bank transfer needs everyone's account.
errores.monedas_distintas: The deliveries have different currencies: a bulk payment has a single currency.

pagos.masivo_descripcion: A bulk bank transfer for several deliveries. Each delivery is paid to its farmer, or to the collector if paid via collector; everyone needs a bank account.
pagos.fuera_precio_one: {{count}} chosen delivery has its price still to be set and is left out.
pagos.fuera_precio_other: {{count}} chosen deliveries have their price still to be set and are left out.
pagos.sin_cuenta_texto: Add the account in their profile or remove those deliveries from the bulk payment. Until then it cannot be recorded.
pagos.elegir_todas: Choose all deliveries with a balance
pagos.orden_no_se_puede_texto: Only orders placed with another company in the value chain can be paid.

ord.descripcion_emitidas: Orders the company placed with other companies in the chain (and customer orders). What the supplier sends stays pending until approved.
ord.descripcion_recibidas: Orders other companies in the chain placed with this one. They are fulfilled by choosing own stock; the buyer approves or rejects it.
ord.vacio_emitidas: No placed orders match these filters.
ord.vacio_recibidas: No received orders match these filters.
ord.aprobar: Approve or reject what was sent for {{orden}}
ord.borrar_pregunta: Delete order {{orden}}? This cannot be undone.
ord.nuevo_descripcion: Choose your own facility that receives the coffee and the order template; then choose which company to order from, how much and by when.
ord.sin_acciones: The company has no order templates
ord.sin_acciones_texto: They are processing actions of the order type, set up in the company Actions tab:
ord.sin_acciones_instalacion: No order template allows this facility.
ord.comprador_nota: The supplier fulfils the order with their own stock; you will see what they send here to approve or reject it.
ord.completar_texto: Choose from your stock what you send to fulfil the order. It stays pending until the buyer approves it.
ord.aprobar_titulo: Approve or reject what was sent
ord.sin_pendientes: There is nothing pending approval in this order.
ord.falta_comentario: To reject a shipment, give the reason.

cli.descripcion: What a customer orders: final products delivered to one of your facilities. Each product becomes an order placed with the chosen supplier, who fulfils it from their stock.
cli.sin_acciones_texto: To order final products, the company needs a final-product order action. Create it in the company Actions tab:
cli.sin_clientes_texto: First register the customer in the current version:
cli.sin_proveedores: No public facility in the value chain sells this product.
cli.precio: Price per unit for the customer

errores.sin_items: The order needs at least one product.

beyco.descripcion_one: Publish the coffee of {{count}} lot on Beyco. The data comes from the lot's traceability; review it before sending.
beyco.descripcion_other: Publish the coffee of {{count}} lots on Beyco. The data comes from each lot's traceability; review it before sending.
beyco.taza_ayuda: From 80 points it is marked as specialty.
beyco.enviada_texto: Beyco received the offer. You can see and edit it from your Beyco account.
beyco.conectar_texto: To publish offers, INATrace needs your authorization on Beyco. We take you to Beyco and you come back here.
beyco.elegir_todos: Select all lots on the page

errores.estado: The Beyco response does not belong to this session. Start again from the stock.
errores.denegado: The authorization on Beyco was denied.
errores.sin_codigo: Beyco did not return the authorization code.
errores.sin_sesion_beyco: The Beyco connection expired. Connect again from the stock.
errores.zaranda_orden: Cannot be lower than the minimum.
errores.coordenada: Out of range (latitude between −90 and 90; longitude between −180 and 180).

productos.descripcion: Your companies' products: details, showcase, the chain's companies, final products and labels with their batches, feedback and statistics. The knowledge base remains in the current version for now.
productos.foto_tipo: The photo must be PNG or JPG.

origen.ayuda: Where the product or its ingredients come from.
origen.instrucciones: Tap the map to add a place; drag the number to move it.
origen.mapa: Map of the places of origin

productos.produccion_ayuda: The production process as the consumer will see it.
productos.politicas_ayuda: Working conditions and social practices along the chain.
productos.idioma_ayuda: Language the product is shown in when the consumer does not choose another.
productos.borrar_pregunta: Delete the product "{{nombre}}" with its labels? This cannot be undone.
productos.nuevo_ayuda: Fill in the profile and save to create the product.
productos.solo_lectura: This product belongs to another company in the chain. Only the owner company can change it.

errores.sin_puntos: Add at least one place of origin on the map.

productos.sin_cadenas_titulo: The company has no value chains
productos.sin_cadenas: A product belongs to one of the company's value chains. They are assigned in the company profile:

vitrina.intro: How the product's public showcase looks. Each label keeps its own copy when created: changes here apply to new labels, and each label can be adjusted separately.
vitrina.apariencia_ayuda: Colors, fonts and images of the showcase.
vitrina.ayuda_fuente_titulo: TTF, WOFF or WOFF2. Used for the product name.
vitrina.ayuda_fuente_texto: TTF, WOFF or WOFF2. Used for the content.
vitrina.ayuda_tamano: PNG or JPG; recommended size {{tamano}} px.
vitrina.pestanas_ayuda: The journey always comes first; the others show when enabled, ordered by position.
vitrina.precios_ayuda: The «Fair prices» charts. World market, Fairtrade and regional average are in USD per pound; manual prices in USD per kg.
vitrina.transparencia_ayuda: Shown with the income chart. Basic formatting (HTML) allowed, as in the current version.
vitrina.recorrido_ayuda: The product's path to the consumer, drawn on the showcase map.
vitrina.recorrido_instrucciones: Tap the map to add a stop; drag the number to move it and use the arrows to reorder.

errores.positivo: A number greater than or equal to 0.

empresas.ayuda: Who takes part in the product's chain. System administration associates them.
empresas.ayuda_admin: Who takes part in the product's chain. As an administrator you can add and remove companies; there must always be an owner.
empresas.ultima_duena: The product must have at least one owner. Add another before removing this one.

acuerdos.ayuda: Agreements signed with the chain's companies about the use of data. Uploaded by the owner.

finales.ayuda: What is sold made from this product (e.g. «Roasted coffee 250 g»), with its unit and the labels that go with it. Used in final processing and orders.
finales.sin_etiquetas_producto: The product has no labels yet.

etiquetas.ayuda: Each label is a showcase of the product, opened by its QR codes. It keeps its own content (copied from the product when created) and chooses what is shown.
etiquetas.nueva_ayuda: The new label copies the product's current content and appearance, and at first shows only its details and the journey.
etiquetas.guarda_antes: Save your changes before publishing or unpublishing the label.
etiquetas.editor_ayuda: Changes here apply only to this label. Mark on each field whether it is shown in the showcase; the preview opens the showcase with your changes, even unsaved.
etiquetas.retirada: The label is no longer shown in the showcase.
etiquetas.publicada_ok: The label is published: its QR codes open the showcase.
etiquetas.borrar_pregunta: Delete the label «{{nombre}}» with its batches? Printed QR codes will stop opening the showcase. This cannot be undone.

empresa.ayuda: The owner company's details are edited in the company profile (current version) and change in all its labels. Here you choose which are shown.
empresa.name: Company name

medios.ayuda: Documents uploaded by the chain's companies in their profiles. Checked ones show in the showcase's «Producers» tab.
medios.vacio: The chain's companies have not uploaded videos or photos yet.
medios.un_video: Choose a single video: the showcase shows one.

lotes.ayuda: Each batch carries its number next to the QR. When enabled, consumers can check authenticity (by dates) and trace the origin (by places).
lotes.autenticidad_ayuda: Consumers confirm the batch with the printed production or expiry date.
lotes.origen_ayuda: Consumers see where this batch comes from.
lotes.reemplazar_lugares: Replace the batch's places with the product's?

errores.una_fecha: Enter at least one of the two dates.
errores.vence_antes: The expiry date cannot be before the production date.
errores.sin_lugares: Add at least one place on the map.
errores.alfanumerico: Only unaccented letters and numbers, without spaces or hyphens.

opiniones.ayuda: What consumers left in this label's showcase. E-mails and answers are only visible to the product's companies.
opiniones.exportar_ayuda: CSV with the e-mails of those who accepted the processing of their data.
opiniones.borrar_pregunta: Delete this feedback? This cannot be undone.

estadisticas.visitas_ayuda: Each scan of a QR code of this label. Updated every minute.
estadisticas.autenticidad_ayuda: Consumer checks that confirmed a batch by its date.
estadisticas.origen_ayuda: Consumer queries for the origin of a batch.

conocimiento.ayuda: Entries about the fairness, quality and provenance of the product, with documents and a video. The public showcase does not show them yet (neither does the current version).
conocimiento.sin_permiso: The knowledge base is managed by the company that owns the product.
conocimiento.tema_fijo: The topic cannot be changed after the entry is created.
conocimiento.video_ayuda: YouTube or other link. https:// is added if missing.
conocimiento.documentos_ayuda: PDF, PNG or JPG; several can be uploaded at once.

ayudas.operacion: Value chains define what can be processed; the base currency is used in deliveries and payments.
ayudas.productores: Farmers the company introduces, with a photo and a quote.

empresa.solo_lectura: The profile is edited by the company's administrators or the system administrators.
empresa.quitar_cadena_pregunta: Remove the “{{cadena}}” chain? Processing on that chain will stop working for the company.
empresa.moneda_ayuda: The currency the company records prices and payments in.
empresa.beyco_ayuda: The company can send lots as offers to the Beyco platform.

errores.sin_cadenas: Add at least one value chain.
errores.sin_salidas: Add at least one output semi-product.

usuarios.ayuda: Who works with this company in INATrace and with which role. Changes are made by the system administrators.
usuarios.ayuda_admin: Change a person's role or remove them from the company. The company cannot be left without an administrator.
usuarios.vacio: The company has no users yet.
usuarios.quitarme_pregunta: Remove yourself from the company? You will no longer see it.
usuarios.ultima_admin: Not possible: this is the only administrator. Give that role to someone else first.
usuarios.sumar_ayuda: Search INATrace accounts by name, surname or e-mail.
usuarios.sin_resultados: No matching accounts (or they are already in the company).

instalaciones.ayuda: Mills, collection centres, warehouses and other places where the company receives, processes or sells. A facility with activity cannot be deleted: deactivate it instead.
instalaciones.ayuda_lectura: Facilities are managed by the company's administrators or the system administrators.
instalaciones.nueva_ayuda: Fill in the details and save to create the facility.
instalaciones.vacio: The company has no facilities yet.
instalaciones.desactivar_pregunta: Deactivate “{{nombre}}”? It will no longer be offered for deliveries and processing.
instalaciones.borrar_pregunta: Delete “{{nombre}}”? Only possible if it has no activity.
instalaciones.mapa_ayuda: Only those shown on the map.
instalaciones.nombre_ayuda: Enter at least one; languages left empty use that same name.
instalaciones.sin_nombre: Enter the name in at least one language.
instalaciones.mapa_instrucciones: Tap the map to place the facility or drag the point.
instalaciones.vende: Does it sell semi-products or final products?
instalaciones.vende_ayuda: Other companies can place orders with it.
instalaciones.productos_ayuda: What can be received and processed at the facility. Semi-products depend on the chosen value chains.
instalaciones.quitar_cadena_pregunta: Remove the “{{cadena}}” chain? The chosen semi-products are cleared and have to be chosen again.
instalaciones.quitar_producto_pregunta: Remove it? Processing with that product will stop working at this facility.

acciones.ayuda: The processes, transfers, orders and QR codes the company can record in stock, with what goes in, what comes out and what is asked when recording them.
acciones.ayuda_lectura: Actions are managed by the company's administrators or the system administrators.
acciones.nueva_ayuda: Fill in the details and save to create the action.
acciones.vacio: The company has no processing actions yet.
acciones.no_se_borra: “{{nombre}}” could not be deleted. If processes were already recorded with this action, the backend does not allow deleting it.

tipos_ayuda.PROCESSING: Turns a semi-product into one or more (for example, cherry into parchment).
tipos_ayuda.FINAL_PROCESSING: Turns a semi-product into a final product (for example, roasted coffee in bags).
tipos_ayuda.SHIPMENT: Template to order semi-products or final products from another company.
tipos_ayuda.TRANSFER: Moves stock from one facility to another without transforming it.
tipos_ayuda.GENERATE_QR_CODE: Gives a lot the QR code of a final product, for the showcase.

secciones.evidencias: What is asked when recording it

acciones.qr_final: Final product of the QR code
acciones.rendimiento_ayuda: Roughly how much comes out for each unit that goes in.
acciones.prefijo_ayuda: Starts the internal number of the lots it produces.
acciones.donde_ayuda: The facilities where this action can start. If none is chosen, it appears in all of them.
acciones.nombre_ayuda: Enter the name in at least one language; empty languages use that name and its description.
acciones.etiqueta_publica_ayuda: What this step is called in the journey the consumer sees.
acciones.evidencias_ayuda: Fields and documents asked when recording the action. They depend on the chosen value chains.
acciones.en_grupo: One of a group on the order
acciones.quitar_cadena_pregunta: Remove the “{{cadena}}” chain? The input semi-product, outputs, fields and documents chosen are cleared.
